failure_class: residual-qualified endpoint near one or more public strict guards where an unconstrained endpoint correction can cross the public semantic boundary

research_basis.geotarget_limit: GeoTarget supplies black-box finite differences and branch/guard discontinuities, so smooth constrained convergence assumptions are not presumed
the experiment uses only a small local trust safeguard and makes no theorem-level convergence claim
h/h2 disagreement and rounding envelopes are diagnostics, not a bound on unsampled derivatives or remainders
E4 has no interval derivative enclosure and is explicitly weaker than validated existence or guard-separation certification

implementation.capability_route: public_guard_count==0 delegates immediately and exactly to the injected matching frozen E1 candidate/shadow; public_guard_count>0 enters E4 without outcome-dependent rerouting
implementation.fallback_injection_contract: factory requires the exact frozen E1 name and complete ordered configuration: base=prod-tol-120x600, callback_cap=600, proof_step=cbrt(eps(Float64)), proof_radius=1e-6, maximum_corrections=3, and matching shadow; altered, omitted, reordered, or extra fields are rejected
implementation.base_qualification: finite in-box base endpoint, valid canonical semantics, and scaled original residual infinity norm at most 1e-12
implementation.coordinates: midpoint/half-range u in [-1,1]^n; equality residuals and public strict guards use their declared positive scales
implementation.guard_contract: exact declared count of distinct strict public guard tokens, positive finite normalized base slacks, positive finite declared scales, and exact opaque branch-token stability; a declared branch capability requires a non-null base token
implementation.lifted_system: H(u,z)=[F(u); g_i(u)/s_i-exp(z_i)] with s_i=g_i(u0)>0 and z_i=0 initially
implementation.exponential_policy: nonfinite, overflowed, underflowed, or zero exp(z_i) is invalid; no z threshold is an acceptance gate
implementation.fd_step: h=cbrt(eps(Float64)) in normalized coordinates with paired h and h/2 Jacobians
implementation.fd_stencil: central when both sides at h and h/2 preserve the exact guard-token set, strict feasibility, semantics, and branch token; otherwise one direction must preserve them at h/2,h,2h and the direction with maximal minimum normalized guard slack is used for both resolutions
implementation.jacobian: finite-difference u columns for scaled F and g/s plus analytic diagonal -exp(z) columns
implementation.rank_error_gate: on the original residual u block, eta=opnorm(abs(Jh-Jh2)+rounding_h+rounding_h2) and min(sigma_min(Jh),sigma_min(Jh2))>2eta
implementation.linear_solve: full-column-rank, column-scaled CPQR at h and h/2; nonfinite, rank-deficient, or solve failure is UNKNOWN
implementation.trust_region: initial radius 1, maximum 4, Euclidean lifted step clipping, fixed alphas [1,1/2,1/4,1/8], Armijo decrease, and actual/predicted reduction ratio strictly greater than 1e-4; radius expansion uses the norm of the accepted effective alpha-times-clipped step, never the pre-backtracking step norm
implementation.final_gate: original and lifted infinity residual at most 1e-12, plus a positive heuristic guard-and-box separation lower model; never a z cutoff
implementation.base_nonqualified_pass_through: E4 does not start; preserve the base endpoint, base status, convergence/acceptance flags, evaluation count, and iteration count exactly, with reason=base-pass-through in the experiment diagnostic
implementation.result_type: a guarded residual-qualified endpoint yields E4_HEURISTIC_GUARD_SEPARATED or E4_HEURISTIC_UNKNOWN; a guarded nonqualified endpoint preserves its base result/status and is not reclassified as an E4 result; never certified, validated, provisional numerical, exact, or an answer authority
implementation.answer_authority: unchanged 512-bit refinement and independent 768-bit canonical replay remain mandatory
implementation.shadow: same callbacks, cache, FD stencils, CPQR proofs, trust trials, correction count, and separation model; return the original base endpoint

accounting_contract.fd_calls: newly charged callbacks requested by an FD stencil
accounting_contract.trial_calls: newly charged callbacks requested by a trust/Armijo alpha
accounting_contract.invalid_fd: charged FD callbacks rejected for callback failure, nonfiniteness, semantics, strict feasibility, guard-token mismatch, or branch mismatch; out-of-box offsets and cache hits do not increment
accounting_contract.invalid_trials: out-of-box alpha without callback, charged trial callback rejected by the public contract, or invalid exponential after a newly evaluated or cached valid-u trial sample; a valid sample rejected only by Armijo/model ratio does not increment
accounting_contract.cache: a cache hit itself causes no new callback and increments no call or invalid counter; subsequent exp(z) validation is independent, and an invalid exponential paired with cached valid u increments invalid_trials
accounting_contract.reported_evaluations: base evaluations plus newly charged FD/trial callbacks and never above 600

truth_blind_inputs: finite bounds and declared variable/residual scales
public guard count and public token/margin/scale/strict observations
h/h2 Jacobian spectrum, model agreement, and callback budget
forbidden_runtime_inputs: case, family, file, primitive, or plugin identity
candidate outcome when selecting the capability lane

pre_outcome_t0.execution_state: targeted fixtures only; no T0 runner or outcome execution is authorized
parameterized_fixtures: residual raw value and matching declared scale multiplied by the same positive factor

NearRank guard-crossing fixture: bounds [-1,1]^2, start (0.25,0.9), F=(x-0.25,5e-13*(y+0.25)), and strict g=y; the base residual 5.75e-13 is qualified but the weak-direction correction is 1.15 and the unique root y=-0.25 is strict-infeasible, so candidate must be UNKNOWN/drop and shadow must execute identical work
pre_outcome_t0.same_work_requirement: candidate and shadow must report identical total callbacks and identical FD/trial/proof/correction/separation diagnostics; only returned endpoint/acceptance role and shadow flag may differ
pre_outcome_t0.future_direct_chart_A_comparator: required later if a direct feasible-chart implementation is frozen; absent and unauthorized here
pre_outcome_t0.future_exp_vs_linear_slack_ablation: if E4 survives targeted T0 and a numerically safe linear-slack formulation is feasible, compare with identical starts, base endpoints, cap, FD stencils, correction count, assessor, and same-work shadow
pre_outcome_t0.orthogonal_replica_boundary: axis-aligned FD does not imply an identical trajectory after a general orthogonal transform; require only answer-class invariance in the later campaign, not targeted-T0 trajectory equality

pre_outcome_kill_gates: any false acceptance of the strict-boundary ghost
any loss of a true positive-margin root at 1e-6, 1e-8, or 1e-12 in the parameterized fixtures

any answer-class change under positive raw guard margin/scale multiplication, guard tuple reorder, opaque guard-token relabel, residual raw-value/declared-scale co-scaling, or signed coordinate permutation
any accepted point with changed branch token, changed guard-token set, invalid strict guard, invalid semantics, or invalid exponential
any candidate endpoint or accepted report on the frozen qualified NearRank guard-crossing fixture, or any candidate/shadow work mismatch there
any candidate/shadow callback or trajectory mismatch
any reported/observed callback mismatch or total above 600
any runtime use of case/family/plugin identity, Gold, or known roots
any certified, validated, provisional-answer, or exact-answer claim from this heuristic
promotion_boundary: Passing targeted T0 only permits an equal-work comparison with the direct feasible-chart and linear-slack controls. It does not authorize a corpus outcome, Core integration, production dependency, or answer-status change.
nonproof_boundary: Without validated derivative and remainder bounds, finite h/h2 samples cannot exclude between-sample oscillation, nonsmoothness, an unseen branch boundary, or loss of strict feasibility. The 512/768-bit canonical validation pipeline remains the answer authority.
